headline: Morgan Stanley Strategist Says US Midterm Election Is Market 'Clearing Event'
summary: Morgan Stanley chief stock-market strategist Mike Wilson stated that the U.S. midterm elections represent a classic clearing event whose outcome will be good news for markets regardless of the result.
why: Morgan Stanley is a major global investment bank. Market commentary from its chief equity strategists is widely monitored by institutional investors for asset allocation guidance.

impacts.name: Morgan Stanley
impacts.why: Morgan Stanley's chief stock-market strategist issued market commentary on the U.S. midterm elections.
